title: Universe levels
current: universe_settings key levels freezes the document at write time. With no row, the universe reads the shipped scheme, so a newer Yoke release brings its new defaults when the server runs it. levels get reports source universe for a stored document, with shipped_defaults_differ saying whether today's shipped defaults differ. yoke universe levels reset (org admin) deletes the row so the universe follows shipped defaults again; set with a document equal to the shipped defaults stores nothing. A project override is cleared by rewriting its session-routing settings without levels. cursor_quota_order keeps the freeze rule and its data-repair deletion.
